description: Arriflex D21 digital camera: R, G and B spectral responses measured with a set of interference filters (camSPECS) in C. Mauer's 2009 diploma thesis (Cologne University of Applied Sciences / Image Engineering), appendix 'Arriflex D-21'.
facility_description: Digital cameras (DSLRs, mirrorless, compact, industrial, cinema and phone cameras) whose RGB channel spectral sensitivities or internal IR/UV-cut filter transmissions have been measured.
notes: SVO's ProfileReference points to https://www.image-engineering.de/content/library/diploma_thesis/christian_mauer_spectral_response.pdf, which now redirects to a generic Image Engineering page; the thesis is available from the TH Koeln repository (https://epb.bibl.th-koeln.de/files/166/Mauer_Christian.pdf).
